acceptedAnswer.text: Your business should consider AI Search Optimization for GEO if you serve customers within specific geographic areas and rely on local foot traffic or geographically targeted online leads. This is particularly beneficial for businesses with physical locations, service area businesses, or those looking to dominate local markets like Chicago or Houston. If you notice competitors outranking you locally or your local customer base isn't growing as expected, AI GEO optimization can provide a strategic advantage.
